status: 5 of 12 release-trigger trials completed and validated; batch continues.
scope: Two engineering Stack scenes, roots zero/one, identity, initial narrow aperture rule and broader stable-closing rule. Both release rules keep the same four-action maximum delay and horizon eight.

batch_report.accounting_scope: Recorded episode costs include failed and incomplete work. Missing fields and unattached physics are explicit; totals may be partial. Elapsed seconds are sums across episodes, not batch wall time.
batch_report.interpretation: Outcome counts cover only validated completed episodes; all other planned jobs remain in statuses. A missing process record does not prove a process is live. This report makes no causal or safety guarantee.

comparison.comparison_scope: Outcome transitions use only cases where both episodes completed and validated. Every planned or unmatched case remains visible. Partial comparisons are not a balanced condition ranking.
comparison.cost_scope: Whole-batch recorded_cost_totals count each episode once, including failed and partial work. Pair totals cover only the completed pairs in that comparison, and are null if a required cost is missing. Controls can appear in several comparisons; never sum pair totals as whole-study costs.
comparison.interpretation: Shared scene/root seeds do not imply identical initial images or physical trajectories. These are descriptive outcome comparisons, not causal counterfactuals or an evolutionary-advantage claim.

diagnostic.held_loss_scope: Goal-checker target only; intermediate object releases are not covered.
diagnostic.handback_counting: Hold actions inferred from the post-action countdown, including the final zero-countdown hold and excluding guard-blocked frames.
diagnostic.interpretation: Temporal associations only; causal repairs require matched episodes.

release_audit.alignment: Proposal i executes before observation i+1. Goal observation i supplies pre-action target holding; a missing observation is unknown, not unheld. Strictly-before counts exclude the action producing the first violation.
release_audit.scope: Goal-checker target only; holds on other objects are not recorded here. Activation and temporal association do not establish that a delay preserved a useful grasp or improved an outcome.

interpretation: All 122 delayed opening commands in the five completed trials occur while the goal target is unheld. Actions match execution and each delay is a prefix of at most four consecutive opening requests. Holds on other objects are outside this diagnostic. No completed identity comparisons or safe completions exist in this partial snapshot; no benefit or condition ranking is established.
